title: Missing moeb tool: Read (fix_signal result file)
description: Used Read to read the oversized fix_signal MCP tool result saved to an external temp file. No moeb equivalent exists for reading paginated large tool output.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb equivalent covering paginated large tool output reading, or cap fix_signal output size to fit within MCP inline limits.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
